Get Basketligaen Player Career

Source: R/sportality.R
sportality_athlete_career.Rd

Player career totals, one row per ssgt.

Endpoint: GET https://www.basketligaen.dk/api/statistics-v2/athlete/playerProfile_gameLog

Usage

sportality_athlete_career(athlete_uuid, master_site_instance_id = NULL)

Arguments

athlete_uuid

(required) Athlete uuid.

master_site_instance_id

(default NULL) Site instance (dbl1_dbl). No effect in the drop-one probe.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Player career totals, one row per ssgt. An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the documented columns come first, in this order (sdv-py sportality_athlete_career), then any column the API added later:

col_nametypedescription
gintegerGames played in the ssgt.
gpsintegerGames started (0 on every row seen).
mpgnumericMinutes per game, 'M.m' string.
ppgnumericPoints per game (a number or.
drpgnumericDefensive rebounds per game.
orpgnumericOffensive rebounds per game.
rpgnumericRebounds per game.
apgnumericAssists per game.
stpgnumericSteals per game.
blkpgnumericBlocks per game.
pfpgnumericPersonal fouls per game.
2_p_percnumericTwo-point percentage, 0-100.
3_pmintegerThree-pointers made (total).
3_panumericThree-pointers attempted (total, or a percentage string in the checked rows; unverified).
3_p_percnumericThree-point percentage, 0-100.
ft_percnumericFree-throw percentage, 0-100.
topgnumericTurnovers per game.
plus_minus_pgnumericPlus/minus per game.
info_uuidcharacterAthlete uuid on player tables, team uuid on team tables (platform key space).
info_full_namecharacterFull display name of the player.
info_first_namecharacterGiven (first) name(s) of the player.
info_last_namecharacterFamily name (surname) of the player.
info_nationalitycharacterISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
info_gendercharacterGender of the person as recorded by the site (male in every row seen).
info_age_valueintegerAge in whole years.
info_age_formatcharacterUnit of the value (years). Values: years = years.
info_weight_valueintegerWeight of the player in kilograms.
info_weight_formatcharacterUnit of the value (kg). Values: kg = kilograms.
info_height_valueintegerHeight of the player in centimetres.
info_height_formatcharacterUnit of the value (cm). Values: cm = centimetres.
info_jersey_numbercharacterJersey number ('N/A' on career rows).
info_positioncharacterPosition code (G, F, C, SG, SF ...).
info_position_codecharacterPosition code ('N/A' on career rows). Values: N/A = not applicable (career rows).
info_shootscharacterShooting hand (null).
info_team_uuidcharacterTeam uuid (platform key space); joins /sports-v2/teams/{team_uuid}.
info_team_instance_idcharacterSite instance id of the club (platform key space).
info_team_namecharacterName of the team.
info_team_codecharacterThree-letter team code.
info_season_statscharacterSeason totals (always empty here).
info_career_statscharacterCareer totals (always empty here).
info_statistics_providercharacterStats provider of the data (genius-basketball = Genius Sports LiveStats).
info_is_in_squadlogicalWhether the player is in the team's current squad.
info_player_idintegerGenius person id (Genius key space; an integer).
info_ssgt_uuidcharacterssgt uuid of the career row (platform key space).
info_team_idintegerGenius team id (Genius key space; an integer here).

Details

  • Unofficial: the JSON API behind www.basketligaen.dk, the Danish men's basketball league (Basketligaen, series code DBL). The site runs on the Sportality platform (the vendor behind the SHL and HockeyAllsvenskan wrappers). The terms page was not read; payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Stats provider: genius-basketball, a relay of Genius Sports LiveStats. The Genius match, team and person ids in play-by-play, box scores and stats tables (game_id, team_id, player_id, all Int64) join the genius family; the platform uuids (game, team, athlete, ssgt) are not Genius ids and exist only on this site. The Genius ORG code of Denmark is not exposed.

  • Season = the END year (2026 = 2025/26) everywhere; the runtime maps it, with game_type ('regular' or 'finals', the playoffs), to the site's ssgt (season + series + game type) through layout-info. Schedules, standings and season tables start in 2002/03; game-level data (play-by-play with shot x/y, box scores, team stats) starts in 2023/24.

  • Source defects the runtime refuses (hoopR_asset_fetch): an unfinished game or a truncated play-by-play feed, a box score or feed that names another game, a cut stats table. The 2002/03 regular-season schedule lists 109 finished games where its own standings count 110: a source gap.

  • Personal data is removed from every body: birth dates, e-mail addresses, phone numbers, addresses and contact blocks.

  • No women's league: Dameligaen has its own domain (dameligaen.dk), which answers 401 to anonymous requests.

  • Errors are classed conditions: hoopR_no_data (404, an empty gameday body, {} / [], a table with no rows, a season or game type layout-info does not list), hoopR_bad_request (a bad argument, a 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (an error envelope or non-JSON 200, a body for another game / team / athlete / ssgt, an unfinished game or truncated play-by-play, a cut stats table, any other non-2xx; a 500 is the site's answer for an unknown uuid and is not retried), all inheriting hoopR_error. Wrappers raise; they never return an empty frame.

 sportality_athlete_career(athlete_uuid = "dpu0901c0t", master_site_instance_id = "dbl1_dbl")
